title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Free Move-In Claim and Included-Miles Credit
content:
**System reference — recording a free move-in claim on a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental contract.**

## Rule

A free move-in claim is recorded on a truck contract for the renter's storage unit with the most recent move-in, which is the storage agreement of the renter's latest storage administrative fee, and when the claim is recorded the claimed miles are credited against the contract's mileage line as a free move-in waiver. From then on the truck contract carries the claim on that storage unit: the storage unit is the contract's linked storage unit.

The included-miles credit is not posted until no other reserved, picked-up or returned truck contract of the renter carries a claim on the same storage unit. The included-miles credit is fixed only after every rental day the contract started stands charged on the contract.

Put the other way round, in the same terms: while any other truck contract of the renter in reserved, picked-up or returned status carries a claim on that storage unit, the credit is not posted; and the credit is not fixed while any rental day the contract started is not yet charged on it.

## What the posting does

`apply_move_in_claim_miles_credit_24951572` sets the contract's linked storage unit to the storage rental agreement given and posts one free move-in waiver credit for the amount given against the mileage charge line given, dated the day of the call; the amount owed on the contract falls by that amount. The renter sees the contract tied to the storage unit and the mileage credit on the invoice.

## How it is invoked

It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `truck_rental_id` | The truck rental contract number the claim is recorded on, read from the truck rental lookup | Identifier |
| `linked_rental_id` | The storage unit rental agreement number the free move-in is claimed for, read from the storage unit rental lookup | Identifier |
| `reference_id` | The id of the mileage charge line being credited, read from the truck contract charge lookup | Identifier |
| `amount` | The mileage credit in USD | Positive amount rounded to 2 decimal places |

## Return

On success the tool returns `status` "credited", `truck_charge_id` (the id of the new credit line), `truck_rental_id`, `linked_rental_id` (the storage agreement now on the contract), `credit_type` "free_move_in_waiver", `reference_id` (the credited mileage line), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `balance_due` (the amount now owed on the contract, USD with 2 decimal places). A status of "credited" means the claim and the credit are recorded.
